technology_name: Health Management Spice Seasoning Mix Formulation
institution: CSIR-National Institute for Interdisciplinary Science and Technology (NIIST)
problem_solved: Need for preventive health management products addressing antidiabetic and cardiovascular issues through daily diet.
description: A seasoning mix formulated by blending various herbs, spices, and medicinal plants in unique proportions based on their evaluated antioxidant, antidiabetic, and cardiovascular protection properties. The manufacturing utilizes equipment like sorters, slicers, hammer mills, and blenders.
applications: • Manufacturing of therapeutic and functional culinary seasonings • Production of health-oriented salad dressings and soup bases • Formulation of functional toppings for commercial snacks like popcorn • Processing of preventive health ingredients for ready-to-eat foods
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, MedTech & Health Care, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
